summary: GasLog Partners LP filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 12, 2026 press release declaring routine quarterly distributions on its Series A, B and C Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Fixed-to-Floating Rate Preference Units. Amounts are $0.5390625, $0.6350530 and $0.6020655 per unit respectively, payable December 15, 2026 to holders of record December 8, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural change is disclosed. This is an ordinary preferred distribution declaration by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K; no special-situations event or risk-arb angle arises.
